en: Vintage monochrome postcard showing a large, fortress‑like military barracks complex on a cobblestone street corner. The multi‑storey brick buildings have crenellated rooflines and corner turrets. Several soldiers and civilians stand near the entrance, and an early motorcar is parked by the sidewalk. A woman in a long skirt and wide‑brimmed hat stands in the foreground under a tree. At the top in red Gothic-style script is a German caption identifying the place.
